He was very insecure, and he had a seriously bruised eye and nose area, as though somebody had just beaten him up — But it wasn't me! He gave me a good first show, with lots of Laughing Machine laughter, which is a real term, but it is what it is, and then reverted back to his former self, and his old ways. I understand that. He's doing his thing. I never took it very personally. I would always mock his Low Ratings, whenever I heard. He's not a nice guy, and what he spouts isn't what he believes. He has to cater to his base, which is mostly composed of Losers, and people who don't like working. It's why, for so long, I didn't get another call from Chuck LaBella, and I didn't miss him one bit. After the second dinner, Bill's "show" was far worse than the first. He went crazy! He's gutless, because he enjoyed every minute. Also, I am not a building a swimming pool in the White House Briefing Room, and never had any intention of doing so. I am thinking about moving the Press, and putting them in a different location, but I will use that location for very badly needed space. Bill also attacked our Great Republican Candidates, when he knows my Endorsement Record is 98% in the House, and 100% in the Senate, so how can he make a false statement like this? These Statistics are FACTS, and he should speak about them, but he won't, because he is very unfair! Karoline Leavitt was GREAT on the show, but she started with a biased, dumb SLEAZEBAG, asking questions. She defended me, and herself, so well, but couldn't be comfortable going against Lie after Lie. Importantly, Bill lied about all of the Illegal Voters in the Radical controlled, decrepit, and devastated State of California. Just in the last few days alone, they found 20,000, and the number could easily go to over 1,000,000. There were so many other falsehoods Bill spewed, but I won't waste time in FACT CHECKING him. He isn't worth it. Bill: Don't call anymore. It's useless, and tell Chuck LaBella not to call so much, and say how much you love "TRUMP," and want to get together, because you're a hopeless guy, who is just trying to cater to your small group of "fans." You're also a coward who is afraid to tell the truth about how well our Country is running because of your few "fans," and how badly the Dumocrats have done, almost destroying the U.S.A. If I hadn't won the Election, it would be DEAD! Also, turn your Laugh Machine off, it's a joke when they laugh uncontrollably, even when you say nothing funny, and I'm going to have the Republicans not cover you anymore, because they try to talk about you as a guy who is transformative. You're not transformative, you're a Loser! I never watched your show much, but I will never watch it again, because it is nothing more than FAKE NEWS that America, and the World, is unfortunately subjected to. Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
